- func_tracktrain: A train, cart or gondola that rides a track of path_tracks; players drive it from a func_traincontrols. Build it facing west, with an origin brush where it sits on the track. Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, zhlt_lightflags, light_origin, target, startspeed, wheels, dmg, volume.
- func_train: Moves along path_corners. Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, zhlt_lightflags, light_origin, target, dmg.
- func_traincontrols: Where players stand to drive a func_tracktrain: inside it, press use to take control, then forward and back to speed up and slow down. Put it on the train. Keys: target.
- func_vehicle: A drivable vehicle. Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, zhlt_lightflags, light_origin, target, length, height.
- func_vehiclecontrols: Where players stand to drive a func_vehicle: like func_traincontrols, for a vehicle. Keys: target.
- func_vip_safetyzone: Where the VIP escapes to on an as_ map. Keys: none.
- func_wall: A wall that isn't part of the world: can be see-through or switched by draw mode. Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, zhlt_lightflags, light_origin.
- func_wall_toggle: A wall that appears and disappears when set off. Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, zhlt_lightflags, light_origin, spawnflags.
- func_water: Water players can swim in. Use a water texture (starting with !). Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, WaveHeight.
- func_weaponcheck: Sets something off when a player inside doesn't carry certain weapons. Keys: targetname, target.
- game_zone_player: When set off, looks at who is inside: sets off In for each player inside and Out for each player outside, and sends both counts to game_counters. Keys: targetname, master, intarget, incount, spawnflags.
- light_surface: Brushes that give off light (newer compilers). Keys: targetname, targetname, _light, pattern, _falloff, spawnflags.
- momentary_door: A door that moves only as far as a momentary_rot_button is turned (a wheel that opens a gate). Point the wheel's target at it. Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, zhlt_lightflags, light_origin, angle, lip, spawnflags.
- momentary_rot_button: A wheel or valve players turn while holding use; its target (a momentary_door) moves as far as it's turned. Needs an origin brush. Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, zhlt_lightflags, light_origin, target, distance, sounds, spawnflags.
- trigger_cdaudio: Plays a CD track (game music) when a player walks in; goes once. Keys: targetname, health.
- trigger_counter: Sets off its target after being set off a number of times. Keys: targetname, target, master, killtarget, delay, message, count.
- trigger_gravity: Changes gravity for whoever walks in. Keys: targetname, gravity.
- trigger_hurt: Hurts (or heals, with negative damage) whoever is inside. Keys: targetname, target, master, dmg, spawnflags.
- trigger_multiple: Sets off its target whenever someone walks in. Keys: targetname, target, master, killtarget, delay, message, wait.
- trigger_once: Sets off its target the first time someone walks in, then is gone. Keys: targetname, target, master, killtarget, delay, message.
- trigger_push: Pushes whoever is inside (jump pads, wind, currents). Keys: targetname, angles, speed.
- trigger_teleport: Sends whoever walks in to its target (an info_teleport_destination). Keys: targetname, target, master, killtarget, delay, message.
- worldspawn: The world: every brush that isn't part of an entity, and the map's settings. Keys: message, wad, MaxRange, sounds, mapteams.
- ambient_generic: Plays a sound, looping or once. Keys: targetname, message, pitch.
- ammo_338magnum: .338 Magnum ammo (AWP). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_357sig: .357 SIG ammo (P228). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_45acp: .45 ammo (USP, MAC-10, UMP45). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_50ae: .50 AE ammo (Desert Eagle). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_556nato: 5.56mm ammo (FAMAS, Galil, M4A1, SG 552, AUG, SG 550). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_556natobox: 5.56mm box (M249). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_57mm: 5.7mm ammo (P90, Five-SeveN). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_762nato: 7.62mm ammo (AK-47, Scout, G3SG1). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_9mm: 9mm ammo (Glock, Dual Elites, MP5, TMP). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- ammo_buckshot: Shotgun shells (M3, XM1014). Keys: angle, spawnflags.
- armoury_entity: A weapon or item lying on the floor for players to pick up. Keys: angle, item, count.
- cycler: A model that plays its animation. Keys: targetname, angles, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, model.
- cycler_sprite: A sprite or model that animates. Keys: targetname, angles, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, model.
- env_beam: A beam (electric arc, rope of light) between two named entities, or from here to a random spot within its radius. Keys: targetname, LightningStart, texture, rendercolor, life, NoiseAmplitude, framestart, damage.
- env_beverage: A drinks machine's chute: drops a soda can each time it's set off (a can gives a little health). Keys: targetname, angle, health.
- env_blood: Sprays blood the way it faces when set off. Keys: targetname, angles, amount.
- env_explosion: An explosion when set off. Keys: targetname, iMagnitude.
- env_fade: Fades players' screens to a color. Keys: targetname, duration, renderamt, spawnflags.
- env_fog: Fog for the whole map. Keys: targetname, startdist, density.
- env_funnel: A funnel of glowing particles pulled in to this spot (or pushed out) when set off; goes once. Keys: targetname, spawnflags.
- env_global: Sets a named global switch when set off. A multisource with the same Global state only works while the switch is on. Keys: targetname, globalstate, initialstate, spawnflags.
- env_glow: A glow sprite that fades out when you can't see its middle. Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, model, scale.
- env_laser: A straight laser from here to a named entity, with an optional sprite where it hits. Keys: targetname, LaserTarget, EndSprite, rendercolor, NoiseAmplitude, framestart, spawnflags.
- env_message: Shows a message from the map's titles.txt when set off, with an optional sound. Keys: targetname, target, message, messagevolume, spawnflags.
- env_rain: Rain on the whole map (players see it outdoors). Keys: none.
- env_render: Changes the draw settings of its target when set off. Keys: targetname, target, rendermode, renderamt.
- env_shake: Shakes players' screens when set off. Keys: targetname, amplitude, duration, spawnflags.
- env_shooter: Throws pieces of any model (or sprite) the way it faces when set off: rubble, glass, cans, shells. Keys: targetname, angles, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, shootmodel, m_iGibs, m_flVelocity, m_flGibLife, skin.
- env_snow: Snow on the whole map (players see it outdoors). Keys: none.
- env_sound: Changes how sounds echo for players near it. Keys: radius.
- env_spark: Sparks, now and then or when set off. Keys: targetname, MaxDelay.
- env_sprite: Shows a sprite (a flat picture, often glowing). Keys: targetname, rendermode, renderamt, renderfx, angles, model, scale, spawnflags.
- game_counter: Counts: up each time it's set off (down when set off as Off). At the limit it sets off its target. game_counter_set and game_zone_player can set its count. Keys: targetname, target, master, frags, spawnflags.
- game_counter_set: Sets a game_counter (its target) to a number when set off. Keys: targetname, target, master, frags.
- game_end: Warning: ends the map for everyone when set off: the scoreboard shows, then the server changes to the next map. Give it a master to limit who can. Keys: targetname, master.
- game_player_equip: Gives every player these items when they spawn (or when set off, if it has a name). Keys: targetname, master, weapon_knife, weapon_glock18, weapon_ak47, weapon_awp, item_kevlar, spawnflags.
- game_player_hurt: Hurts (or heals, with negative damage) the player who sets it off, then sets off its target. Keys: targetname, target, master, dmg.
- game_player_team: Warning: moves the player who sets it off to another team (the team of its target game_team_master), and can kill them. Changes the teams for the rest of the map. Keys: targetname, master, target.
- game_score: Gives points (kills on the scoreboard) to the player who sets it off, or to their team. Keys: targetname, master, points.
- game_team_master: Passes a signal on only if the player who set it off is on its team. Also a master: name it as the Master of a button, door or game_ entity so only that team can use it. Keys: targetname, target, master, teamindex, triggerstate, spawnflags.
- game_team_set: Sets its target game_team_master to the team of the player who set this off (or clears it): capture points, team-owned buttons. Keys: targetname, target, master, spawnflags.
- game_text: Shows text on screen when set off. Keys: targetname, target, master, message, y, color, fadein, holdtime, channel, spawnflags.
- gibshooter: Throws gibs (body pieces) the way it faces when set off. Keys: targetname, angles, m_iGibs, m_flVelocity, m_flGibLife.
- hostage_entity: A hostage for the Counter-Terrorists to rescue (cs_ maps). Keys: angle, model.
- info_bomb_target: A bomb site point (instead of a func_bomb_target brush). Keys: none.
- info_hostage_rescue: A point hostages can be rescued at (instead of a func_hostage_rescue brush). Keys: none.
- info_map_parameters: Map rules: who may buy, how big the bomb blast is. Keys: buying, bombradius.
- info_null: A point used only while compiling; gone in the game. Keys: targetname.
- info_player_deathmatch: Terrorist spawn point. Add at least as many as the team can have players. Keys: targetname, target, angle.
- info_player_start: Counter-Terrorist spawn point. Add at least as many as the team can have players. Keys: targetname, target, angle.
- info_target: A point other entities aim at (spotlights, beams, cameras). Keys: targetname.
- info_teleport_destination: Where a trigger_teleport sends players. Keys: targetname, angle.
- info_vip_start: Where the VIP starts on an assassination (as_) map. Keys: targetname, target, angle.
- infodecal: A decal (a painted-on picture like a crack or blood) on the nearest wall. Keys: targetname, angles, texture.
- item_assaultsuit: Kevlar and helmet: armor up to 100 with a helmet. Keys: angle, target.
- item_battery: A battery: adds 15 armor (or Armor), up to 100. Keys: angle, target, armorvalue.
- item_healthkit: A health kit: heals 15 (or Health). Comes back after mp_item_respawn_time (30 s) unless told not to. Keys: angle, target, health.
- item_kevlar: Kevlar: armor up to 100. Keys: angle, target.
- item_longjump: The long jump module: crouch and jump to leap far, until the player dies. Keys: angle, target.
- item_thighpack: A defuse kit (Counter-Terrorists only). Keys: angle, target.
- light: A light that shines in every direction. Keys: targetname, _light, pattern, _falloff, spawnflags.
- light_environment: The sun: lights everything that can see the sky. Use one per map. Keys: angle, pitch, _diffuse_light.
- light_spot: A spotlight: a cone of light pointing at its target or along its angles. Keys: targetname, _light, pattern, _falloff, spawnflags, target, angles, _cone, _sky.
- multi_manager: Sets off several things, each after its own delay. Add keys: the name to set off, and the seconds to wait. Keys: targetname, spawnflags.
- multisource: On only while everything that targets it is on (an AND gate). Use as a master. Keys: targetname, target, globalstate.
- path_corner: A stop on a path for trains and cameras. Keys: targetname, target, wait, message.
- path_track: A stop on a func_tracktrain's track. Link them in order with Next stop; the train rides them in that order. Keys: targetname, target, message, spawnflags.
- player_weaponstrip: Takes away all of a player's weapons when set off. Keys: targetname.
- target_cdaudio: Plays a CD track (game music) when a player comes within its radius, or when set off; goes once. Keys: targetname, health.
- trigger_auto: Sets off its target when the round starts. Keys: target, delay, triggerstate, spawnflags.
- trigger_camera: Shows players the view from here for a while when set off. Keys: targetname, target, wait, speed.
- trigger_changetarget: Changes what another entity sets off. Keys: targetname, target, m_iszNewTarget.
- trigger_random: Sets off one of its targets at random each time it's set off. Timed: picks on its own after a random wait, until set off again. Unique: never the same target twice until all have gone. Keys: targetname, target_count, target1, target3, target5, target7, target9, target11, target13, target15, min_delay, spawnflags.
- trigger_random_time: The old name for trigger_random with Timed on: after a random wait it sets off one of its targets, again and again until set off. Setting it off starts and stops it. Keys: targetname, target_count, target1, target3, target5, target7, target9, target11, target13, target15, min_delay, spawnflags.
- trigger_random_unique: The old name for trigger_random with Unique on: each time it's set off it picks a target that hasn't gone yet; when all have gone it stops (or starts over). Keys: targetname, target_count, target1, target3, target5, target7, target9, target11, target13, target15, spawnflags.
- trigger_relay: Passes a signal on: sets off its target, maybe later, maybe as on or off. Keys: targetname, target, killtarget, delay, triggerstate, spawnflags.
- trigger_setorigin: Moves entities to another entity when set off (or keeps them following it): a lift that carries a sprite, a light that follows a train. Keys: targetname, target, offset, invert_x, invert_y, invert_z, spawnflags.
- ls_barnacle (Barnacle): A barnacle on the ceiling (needs Loner-Strike's game DLL). Put it right under the ceiling: its tongue hangs to the floor, and a player who walks into it is hauled up and chewed until someone shoots it. It comes back every round. Keys: health, length, hates.
- ls_creature (Creature): A creature placed in the map (needs Loner-Strike's game DLL; types from creatures.ini). It comes back every round. Keys: type, behaviour, path, respawn, speed, aggression, hates, persist, flee_hp, tier, angles.
- ls_barricade (Barricade): A wall that can be shot or hit down and repaired (hold USE). Bots defend behind it and go round it while it stands. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, hp, team, repair_secs, blocks_bots, friendly_damage, fit, size, adopt.
- ls_wave_spawner (Wave spawner): Where waves of enemies come from (Last Stand). Waves are shared by every spawner on the map. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, team, wave_min, waves, radius, auto, prepare, humans.
- ls_moving_platform (Moving platform): Tells bots about a func_train / func_plat (they wait for it and ride it) and reports when it stops and starts. Keys: targetname, enabled, platform.
- ls_timed_door (Timed door): Opens, closes and locks func_doors on a timetable. Players may lock it for a while. Bots go round a locked door. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, team, door, close_at, locked_until, lock_time.
- ls_trigger_trap (Trap): A trap: sets off its targets (and hurts players inside) when someone walks in, or when a button or mode fires it. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, radius, size, fire_on, team_only, delay, rearm_secs, danger, trap_kind, active_secs, creature_dps_pct, bots_auto.
- ls_loot_container (Loot crate): A crate players hold USE on to open; it gives a few items from a loot table. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, friendly, tier, table, open_secs, respawn_secs, model.
- ls_supply_drop (Supply drop): Where a supply crate can fall from the sky, with a beacon. Players hold USE on it to open it. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, friendly, tier, at, fall_secs, items, beacon.
- ls_weapon_spawner (Weapon spawner): A weapon or item lying on the floor that comes back after it's taken. Walk over it to pick it up. Keys: targetname, enabled, friendly, tier, item, once.
- ls_capture_point (Capture point): A point teams take by standing on it, and hold. Bots attack and defend it. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, radius, size, capture_secs, decay, start_owner, ffa.
- ls_checkpoint (Checkpoint): A gate in a race. Players pass them in order; passing the last one finishes a lap. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, radius, size, team, order.
- ls_extraction_zone (Extraction): Players who stay inside long enough while it's open get out (and are done for the round). Keys: targetname, enabled, target, radius, size, team, hold_secs, close_at, shared, once, action.
- ls_interactable (Interactable): Anything players use with E: a lever, a terminal, a note, a pickup. Shows its prompt when looked at, then sets off its targets. Keys: targetname, enabled, team, prompt, cooldown, hide, bots, model, target.
- ls_interactable_brush (Interactable brush): A brush players use with E (a lever, a console, a hatch). Shows its prompt when looked at, then sets off its targets. In the game it is an ls_interactable. Keys: targetname, enabled, prompt, cooldown, hide, bots, team, target.
- ls_npc (NPC): A character players talk to: press E to start a conversation (a game mode can add lines and replies). It can stand, wander, patrol or follow, and faces whoever talks to it. Bots never shoot it while it's unkillable and walk round it. Keys: targetname, enabled, model, targets, follow_secs, health, greet, team, target.
- ls_event: Loner-Strike: fires a Studio custom event when triggered Keys: targetname, a.
- ls_meeting_point (Meeting point): Players hold USE here to call a meeting: everyone gathers, talks and votes someone out. Keys: targetname, enabled, target, size, radius, cooldown, callers, freeze, gather.
- ls_player_class (Player class): A player class: health, speed, weapons, model. Players pick one with say /class, or a mode gives it. Keys: team, name, hp, helmet, speed, weapons, model, menu, default, bot_profile.
- ls_respawn_point (Respawn point): Where players of a team (re)spawn in a mode. When a map has any for a team, that team spawns only at these, at a free one. Keys: targetname, enabled, team, angle, role.
- ls_mystery_box (Mystery box): A random gun for a price. Of the boxes in one group, one is out at a time; after a few uses it moves to another. Keys: targetname, enabled, team, price, super, super_name, group, bots.
- ls_perk_machine (Perk machine): Sells one perk for as long as the player lives (lost when downed). Hold USE at it to buy. Keys: targetname, enabled, team, perk, price, max_perks, bots.
- ls_shop (Shop): A shop counter: players inside press USE for a menu of priced items. Can have a shopkeeper (Barney or the G-Man) who greets and thanks them. Keys: targetname, enabled, team, radius, size, items, scale, buy_menu, keeper, greet, title.
- ls_upgrade_bench (Upgrade bench): Upgrades the gun in hand: Mk II (+40% damage, a magazine and a half), then Mk III (+90%). The level stays with the gun. Keys: targetname, enabled, team, price2, level3_from, dmg3, bots.
- ls_damage_zone (Damage zone): Hurts players inside: fire, poison, shock. Bots route around it. Keys: targetname, enabled, size, radius, interval, team, hud_warning, show.
- ls_safe_zone (Safe zone): The safe circle (battle royale). Players outside it take damage. Put one in the middle of the play area. Keys: targetname, enabled, radius, interval.
- ls_zone_shrinker (Zone shrinker): Shrinks a safe zone in stages: warn (next circle shown), then close in, with more damage each stage. Keys: targetname, enabled, zone, start_delay, final_r.
